name: PvZ2 Gardendless iOS
subtitle: Plants vs. Zombies 2: Gardendless for iOS & iPadOS
description: Official iOS port of Plants vs. Zombies 2: Gardendless, featuring touch controls, 120 FPS ProMotion support, auto-collect, auto fast-forward, and iPadOS optimizations.

apps.name: PvZ2 Gardendless
apps.subtitle: PvZ 2 PC fan-game adapted for iOS & iPadOS
apps.localizedDescription: Plants vs. Zombies 2: Gardendless ported to iOS and iPadOS with complete touch controls, ProMotion 120Hz support, in-game performance menu, auto-collect, and save management.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Synchronized with PC version 0.16.8 (Aqua Vine, Kungfu Zomboss, Lawn Rift).
• Fixed startup loading freeze at 'Loading SFXs'.
• Fixed false in-game update to 0.16.8 notification.
• Added 126 new audio files and 44 updated asset packs.
• Fixed conveyor belt and Piñata Party crash.
• Retained 120 FPS ProMotion, Auto-Collect, and Auto Fast-Forward.

• 120 FPS ProMotion support for iPad Pro and iPhone Pro.
• In-game settings menu with Auto-Collect & Auto Fast-Forward toggles.
• Audio lifecycle fixes and volume balancing.
• Multi-lane plant performance optimization.

news.title: PvZ2 Gardendless v0.16.8 Released!
news.caption: Updated to PC version 0.16.8 with Aqua Vine, crash fixes, and 126 new audio files.
